name: std-learn-classify
description: Generic classify-with-feedback instrument — items are presented one at a time on a current-item card (with an optional config-declared hint), the learner picks a category from an ordered stacked-backdrop ladder (the picked rung rings, the correct rung glows green, a wrong pick glows red), an explicit verdict beat shows a correct/incorrect badge plus a config-declared explanation, a progress readout tracks item k of n and a running score, and after the last item the learner reaches an end-of-round summary with a per-category breakdown and a Retry affordance. Category and item vocabulary is entirely config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any classification domain (needs hierarchies, checks-and-balances, sociological imagination, and beyond) on a biology-canvas. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

schema.description: Generic classify-with-feedback instrument — items are presented one at a time on a current-item card (with an optional config-declared hint), the learner picks a category from an ordered stacked-backdrop ladder (the picked rung rings, the correct rung glows green, a wrong pick glows red), an explicit verdict beat shows a correct/incorrect badge plus a config-declared explanation, a progress readout tracks item k of n and a running score, and after the last item the learner reaches an end-of-round summary with a per-category breakdown and a Retry affordance. Category and item vocabulary is entirely config-declared, so the same mechanism serves any classification domain (needs hierarchies, checks-and-balances, sociological imagination, and beyond) on a biology-canvas. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.
schema.name: std-learn-classify

advanceLabel.description: Label text for the button that advances to the next item.
advanceLabel.label: Advance Button Label

advanceMs.description: Milliseconds between automatic advances while running — the 32ms base tick accumulates elapsed time and fires ADVANCE each time this interval elapses.
advanceMs.label: Auto-Advance Interval (ms)

autoRun.description: When true the advance clock starts on load and the drill flips to the next item every advanceMs milliseconds; toggle live with the Auto/Pause button.
autoRun.label: Auto Run

categories.description: Ordered bottom-to-top roster of category buckets (value/label/color) used to render the stacked backdrop and the pick buttons; order determines the backdrop's stacking, widest at the bottom to narrowest at the top.
categories.label: Categories
categories.synonyms: category, bucket, class, tier, level, classification, roster

correctColor.description: Fill color for the correct category once the learner has picked.
correctColor.label: Correct Highlight Color

incorrectColor.description: Fill color for the learner's picked category when it does not match the correct category.
incorrectColor.label: Incorrect Highlight Color

interactive.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.
interactive.label: Interactive

default.explanation: This example was written to satisfy category A's defining trait.
default.hint: Consider what makes this belong to category A.

default.explanation: This example was written to satisfy category B's defining trait.
default.hint: Consider what makes this belong to category B.

items.description: Roster of items the learner classifies; each carries its prompt text, the value of its correct category, and optional hint/explanation text shown before/after the pick.
items.label: Items
items.synonyms: item, prompt, scenario, situation, case, example, question

loopRound.description: When true the item cursor wraps past the last item forever (a looping drill) instead of ending the round at the summary screen.
loopRound.label: Loop Round

matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
matchMode.label: Match Mode

orderStride.description: Items advance by this stride through the roster — 1 is sequential; a stride coprime with the roster length (e.g. 3) interleaves the corpus so adjacent items differ.
orderStride.label: Order Stride

passScore.description: Target score shown next to the running score as "pass at N"; 0 hides the target.
passScore.label: Pass Score

penaltyPerMiss.description: Rubric points subtracted for each incorrect pick (score never drops below 0).
penaltyPerMiss.label: Penalty Per Miss

pointsPerCorrect.description: Rubric points added to the score for each correct pick; at the default 1 with no penalty, the plain correct/attempted counts render instead of the rubric score.
pointsPerCorrect.label: Points Per Correct

retryLabel.description: Label text for the button that restarts the round from the end-of-round summary.
retryLabel.label: Retry Button Label

scoreCap.description: Upper bound on the rubric score; 0 means uncapped.
scoreCap.label: Score Cap

showHint.description: Show each item's hint line beneath the prompt before the learner picks; hide for a harder drill.
showHint.label: Show Hint

emits.description: The classification state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: classify update, pick result, score, running score, verdict

emits.description: Fired once when the round finishes (the advance past the final item) — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.
events.name: Mode Selected

events.description: Learner picked a category for the current item; verdicted against the item's declared correct category.
events.name: Pick

events.description: Learner advanced to the next item, clearing the pick and feedback for the new item; on the last item this instead ends the round and reveals the summary.
events.name: Advance

events.description: Learner restarted the round from the summary screen — score, per-category breakdown, and item cursor reset to the beginning.
events.name: Retry

events.description: Learner toggled auto-advance: while running, the advance clock steps to the next item every advanceMs milliseconds.
events.name: Toggle Run

events.description: The classification state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.name: Classify Updated
events.synonyms: classify update, pick result, score, running score, verdict

events.description: Fired once when the round finishes (the advance past the final item) — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
events.name: Learn Round Complete

orbital LearnClassifyOrbital {
  type LearnClassifyShapePoint = {
    x : number!
    y : number!
  }
  type LearnClassifyShape = {
    type : "line" | "arrow" | "circle" | "rect" | "polygon" | "path" | "text" | "axis" | "grid"!
    id : string
    x : number
    y : number
    x1 : number
    y1 : number
    x2 : number
    y2 : number
    radius : number
    width : number
    height : number
    points : [LearnClassifyShapePoint]
    path : string
    text : string
    label : string
    fontSize : number
    align : "left" | "center" | "right"
    axis : "x" | "y"
    min : number
    max : number
    step : number
    color : string
    fill : string
    lineWidth : number
    opacity : number
  }
  type LearnClassifyItemOption = {
    category : string!
    label : string!
  }
  type LearnClassifyItem = {
    text : string!
    category : string!
    hint : string
    explanation : string
    options : [LearnClassifyItemOption]
  }
  type LearnClassifyOption = {
    value : string!
    label : string!
    color : string!
  }
  type LearnClassifyCategoryStat = {
    category : string!
    label : string!
    attempted : number!
    correct : number!
  }

  entity LearnClassifyScene [runtime] {
    id : string!
    active : boolean = false
    title : string
    itemIndex : number
    itemText : string
    itemHint : string
    itemExplanation : string
    correctCategory : string
    selectedCategory : string
    feedback : string
    verdict : string
    correctCount : number
    attemptedCount : number
    totalItems : number
    roundComplete : boolean = false
    running : boolean = false
    elapsedMs : number = 0
    score : number = 0
    categoryStats : [LearnClassifyCategoryStat]
    backdropShapes : [LearnClassifyShape]
    roundView : [node]
  }

  trait LearnClassifySim -> @rebindable LearnClassifyScene [interaction, instance] {
    initial: idle

    state idle {
      INIT -> idle when (== @config.matchMode "")
        (set @entity.active true)
        (set @entity.title @config.title)
        (set @entity.itemIndex 0)
        (set @entity.correctCount 0)
        (set @entity.attemptedCount 0)
        (set @entity.selectedCategory "")
        (set @entity.feedback "")
        (set @entity.verdict "")
        (set @entity.roundComplete false)
        (set @entity.running @config.autoRun)
        (set @entity.elapsedMs 0)
        (set @entity.score 0)
        (set @entity.totalItems (array/len @config.items))
        (set @entity.categoryStats (array/map @config.categories (fn c { category: (object/get @c value), label: (object/get @c label), attempted: 0, correct: 0 })))
        (let (
            (item (array/nth @config.items 0))

          (do
            (set @entity.itemText (object/get @item text))
            (set @entity.itemHint (object/get @item hint ""))
            (set @entity.itemExplanation (object/get @item explanation ""))
            (set @entity.correctCategory (object/get @item category))

        )
        (let (
            (categoryCount (array/len @config.categories))

            (marginY 20)
            (plotWidth (- @config.width (* @marginX 2)))
            (plotHeight (- @config.height (* @marginY 2)))
            (plotBottom (- @config.height @marginY))
            (tierHeight (/ @plotHeight @categoryCount))
            (maxWidth (* @plotWidth 0.95))
            (minWidth (* @plotWidth 0.3))
            (widthStep (/ (- @maxWidth @minWidth) (- @categoryCount 1)))
            (centerX (/ @config.width 2))
            (revealed (!= @entity.selectedCategory ""))
            (rects (array/flatten (array/map (array/range @categoryCount) (fn i (let (
                  (category (array/nth @config.categories @i))
                  (categoryValue (object/get @category value))
                  (w (- @maxWidth (* @i @widthStep)))
                  (yTop (- @plotBottom (* (+ @i 1) @tierHeight)))

                  (isSelectedCategory (== @categoryValue @entity.selectedCategory))

            (set @entity.itemExplanation (object/get @item explanation ""))

      advanceLabel : string = "Next"
        @label "Advance Button Label"
        @description "Label text for the button that advances to the next item."
        @tier "presentation"
      showHint : boolean = true
        @label "Show Hint"
        @description "Show each item's hint line beneath the prompt before the learner picks; hide for a harder drill."
        @tier "domain"
      passScore : number = 0
        @label "Pass Score"
        @description "Target score shown next to the running score as \"pass at N\"; 0 hides the target."
        @tier "domain"
      autoRun : boolean = false
        @label "Auto Run"
        @description "When true the advance clock starts on load and the drill flips to the next item every advanceMs milliseconds; toggle live with the Auto/Pause button."
        @tier "domain"
      advanceMs : number = 900
        @label "Auto-Advance Interval (ms)"
        @description "Milliseconds between automatic advances while running — the 32ms base tick accumulates elapsed time and fires ADVANCE each time this interval elapses."
        @tier "domain"
      orderStride : number = 1
        @label "Order Stride"
        @description "Items advance by this stride through the roster — 1 is sequential; a stride coprime with the roster length (e.g. 3) interleaves the corpus so adjacent items differ."
        @tier "domain"
      loopRound : boolean = false
        @label "Loop Round"
        @description "When true the item cursor wraps past the last item forever (a looping drill) instead of ending the round at the summary screen."
        @tier "domain"
      pointsPerCorrect : number = 1
        @label "Points Per Correct"
        @description "Rubric points added to the score for each correct pick; at the default 1 with no penalty, the plain correct/attempted counts render instead of the rubric score."
        @tier "domain"
      penaltyPerMiss : number = 0
        @label "Penalty Per Miss"
        @description "Rubric points subtracted for each incorrect pick (score never drops below 0)."
        @tier "domain"
      scoreCap : number = 0
        @label "Score Cap"
        @description "Upper bound on the rubric score; 0 means uncapped."
        @tier "domain"
      retryLabel : string = "Retry Round"
        @label "Retry Button Label"
        @description "Label text for the button that restarts the round from the end-of-round summary."
        @tier "presentation"
    }
  }

  page "/learn-classify" as LearnClassifyPage -> LearnClassifySim
}
